'''Bespin Direct''' was a travel agency that was a member of the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the company offered daily nonstop trips to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] on board a fleet of [[Bespin Direct StarSpeeder 1000|customized]] [[StarSpeeder 1000]]s. At the time, Bespin Direct operated a [[Passenger liner/Legends|spaceliner]] terminal on [[Spaceport THX1138]]'s north wing. The company's slogan was, "The non-stop spaceline that never stops caring."
